posts.post: I stopped buying fast fashion when I realized I was just paying for polyester sweat and landfill filler. If it’s not made to order, it’s not coming in my closet. Agree or am I reaching?
Skinny jeans weren't the problem, the cheap, non-stretchy fabric was. We’re bringing the silhouette back, but with actual quality this time. Agree or am I reaching?
There is a massive difference between looking pretty and having diva energy. Pretty is a trend, but the energy comes from wearing something that actually fits your soul. Agree or am I reaching?
